new_issues.title: step_offsite discards the WAL push command's result and relies only on rclone check.
new_issues.why: shell(tick_commands()['push'], step) is called and its CompletedProcess is dropped; the step then requires rclone check --one-way to pass for base/, metadata/ and wal/. A failed push with a remote that already matches still leaves every checked file offsite, which is what the step verifies, so no wrong outcome follows; checking the push exit code would only surface a broken push job earlier.

new_issues.title: setup-backup.sh creates the --rehearse directory even in --check mode.
new_issues.why: mkdir -p "$REHEARSE" runs unconditionally when --rehearse is given, but that line is unchanged from base; the diff only added the ROOT_OF remapping after it. It also only creates the scratch directory the caller named.

new_issues.title: The cutover's provision step can restart 17/tick through provision_tick_cluster.sh without rechecking the tick advisory lock.
new_issues.why: apply_settings in provision_tick_cluster.sh restarts the unit when pg_settings reports PENDING RESTART, with no lock check, and the cutover now calls it in step 3, seconds after the step 1 lock check. That restart path is unchanged from base and fires only if the tick cluster's provisioning settings have drifted; on manta9000 the cluster was already provisioned, and TD6 notes no tick timers exist, so a run starting in that window needs a manual start during the cutover. True but needs unlikely conditions; not merge-blocking.

new_issues.title: run_lib names the failing library 'env' for the per-cluster pg_settings call.
new_issues.why: After shift, $1 is 'env' for run_lib "$C" env PGCLUSTER=... pg_settings.sh, so a silent non-zero exit reports 'MISSING 17/main env exited N'. Base already called run_lib env PGCLUSTER=... and used basename "$1", giving the same 'env' label; the diff only added the prefix. The line is still caught as not-OK, so it is a label defect that predates the change.

new_issues.title: ctx.lifecycle is filled only in step 12, so a failed run's report has no B2 console rules section.
new_issues.why: lifecycle_missing is applied only to step_production's setup-backup output, so an earlier failure leaves ctx.lifecycle empty and render_report omits the TD10 section. The same MISSING 17/tick lifecycle lines are recorded verbatim in step 2's Seen output in the report, and the rules matter only once a re-run completes, so the information is not lost.

new_issues.title: ensure_dir re-owns production's /data/backup, base/ and metadata/ to manta:manta 775 outside TD3's guarantee.
new_issues.why: The constants comment states manta:manta 775 is production's shape since 915, the slice design's step 2 expects every 17/main dir-* -owner-mode item OK, and step_check's CHECK_ALLOWED admits no 17/main item, so any production shape drift stops the cutover before apply (a unit test covers exactly that DRIFT). The 2026-10-05 cutover report shows all 17/main dir-*-owner-mode items OK at step 2, so nothing was re-owned.
